$comment: Typed adapter registry (improvement plan workstream 10). Every ticket class maps to exactly one adapter or to the human-handoff adapter; tests/validate-playbook.mjs fails when a class maps to none. An adapter declares what it can read, write, verify, and roll back, which credential it uses, its error taxonomy, and the classes it serves. 'implemented' means code exists in the named tool; 'handoff' means a person acts and the agent verifies.

wordpress-alpha-mcp.tool: Alpha WordPress MCP bridge and plugin 0.5.x

hubspot-programs.tool: APEX campus editor (two-way sync) for writes; growth map API mirror for reads until crm.objects.custom.read is granted
hubspot-programs.credential: HUBSPOT_SERVICE_KEY (reads, scopes pending); APEX editor session for writes
read: growth map API (type, name, address, city, state, url, communityUrl, coordinates, gradeRange, launchDate, photoUrl)
write: APEX campus editor: type, visibility, year open, address, city, state, calendar, tuition, application fee, start and end grade, email, phone, website, admission link, call scheduling link, website intro copy
HubSpot UI by an authorized person with the ticket id in the property note
verify: page check after the nightly n8n run
rollback: previous value from HubSpot property history

n8n-sync.system: n8n workflows (Update school pages ORgdHC71YJ5RawBy, Locations RqP1lPvDKvHDxTus)
n8n-sync.tool: n8n cloud API (trilogyinc.app.n8n.cloud), read-only: workflows, nodes, executions with data; writes remain owner-only until the write policy (trailing audit per change) is recorded
n8n-sync.credential: N8N_API_KEY (Matt Barge personal key, marketingsupport .env; catalogued in the Superbuilders context secrets)
read: list_revisions on the page (n8n user saves)

keyWorkflows.ORgdHC71YJ5RawBy: alpha.school website: Update school pages (nightly 05:15 UTC; writes the 24 synced ids)
keyWorkflows.RqP1lPvDKvHDxTus: alpha.school website: Update the Locations Page
keyWorkflows.6HvmvgkzPkFikc40: Read programs and their marketing events (HubSpot Programs + Marketing Events + HubDB FormProgramInterestToInterestAndCampusMapping)

events-hubspot.system: HubSpot marketing events and the Alpha HubSpot Events plugin
write: event owner in HubSpot or APEX

packets.system: campus info packets (Canva masters, Flipsnack, Drive)
packets.tool: registry/campus-packets.json (read); packet owner acts; link edits through wordpress-alpha-mcp
verify: logged-out 200 on the approved packet link

forms-admissions.tool: none; registry/forms.json has no form ids yet

human-handoff.system: a named person in another system
human-handoff.tool: APEX assignment with the contract's fix path
verify: the class's done condition, checked by the website agent when public

apex-request-assets.system: APEX request assets (staff headshots) in the request-assets Supabase bucket
apex-request-assets.tool: APEX public headshot routes (/api/public/request-assets/headshot, finalize) and the operator-reviewed binding route (/api/agent/tasks/{id}/staff-asset-binding); playbook tool agent/bind-headshot.mjs
apex-request-assets.credential: APEX_API_TOKEN (operator key with website-operator assignment) for the binding; the public upload is owned by APEX_OPERATOR_EMAIL
write: POST /api/public/request-assets/headshot (create + finalize, checksum recomputed by APEX)
POST /api/agent/tasks/{id}/staff-asset-binding (attach a VERIFIED asset to the ticket with source provenance)
apex-request-assets.note: Decision 2026-09-21: a headshot that arrived as a Drive, Slides, or Slack link is reviewed by the website operator and bound as an APEX asset; the agent never fetches the link itself. Binding route ships in APEX PR agent/headshot-bind.
